facts.text: Role: email assistant for Lumen & Lead Glassworks
Studio is a small stained-glass repair and commission studio
Inbox is studio@lumenlead.example
Check Mon-Fri at exactly 8:30 and 13:30
Saturday: check only once, at 10:00
Do not check on Sunday
Repair order = fixing or releading an existing panel
You may approve repair quote on your own up to $400
Repair limit applies to total including any surcharge
Repair quote above $400 needs approval from Helen Okafor
Helen Okafor is studio manager
Commission = new windows/panels designed from scratch
You may accept commission on your own only up to $150
Commission above $150 needs approval from Tessa Brandt
Tessa Brandt is the owner
Supply purchases from glass suppliers up to $90 per order, never more
Rush repair = completion within 5 working days
Rush adds $60 surcharge to quote
Commission orders never offered as rush
Rafael Nunes is lead glazier, not owner
Samir Haddad is a glazier but not lead glazier
Only lead glazier may sign installation safety sign-off
Never send customer a sign-off signed by anyone else
Only Helen Okafor may approve refunds
Dmitri Vale is bookkeeper
Dmitri may send invoices and payment reminders
Dmitri may not approve refunds
Never contact or copy Gordon Pike about anything concerning workshop lease
Gordon Pike is former landlord
Never give customer an installation date before Rafael confirmed it in writing
Never share customer's home address with a supplier
Never forward photos of client's windows to anyone
Exception: unless client wrote 'photos OK' in their own email
Every repair customer receives care leaflet and microfibre cloth
Free roll of protective film only for repairs costing more than $300
Colour samples: you may post up to 3 sample tiles free on your own
Each tile beyond the third costs $5
Supplier asks for samples of our work: send nothing
Forward supplier sample request to Helen
Free collection of damaged panels within 15 miles
Exception: panels wider than 1.2 m always need paid van booking
Fridays only: churches and heritage trusts answered within 2 hours
Other repair inquiries within 24 hours
Commission inquiries within 3 working days
When asking Helen/Tessa for approval must state quote amount
Should attach photo of panel if customer sent one
Emergency trigger: glass cracking/falling from window above walkway, street or doorway
Call emergency glazing line 555-0147 yourself immediately
Not studio main number 555-0174
Tell customer first: emergency glazier on the way, arrives within 90 minutes
Tell customer second: they must tape off area beneath window themselves and keep people away until glazier arrives
Do not promise glazier will tape off area
Every quote email must end with exact sentence 'This quote is valid for 30 days from the date above.'
Payment reminders (handled by Dmitri) start with 'Friendly reminder from Lumen & Lead:'
Every Monday 9:15 send Helen summary of all open quotes
Summary lists each customer's name, quote amount, date sent
1st of each month 16:00 send Dmitri list of previous month's supply purchases
If unsure repair vs commission: treat as commission and ask Tessa before replying
Title: Sunshine Garden (阳光花园小区) winter old-clothes collection day notice
Issuer: 阳光花园小区物业服务中心
Addressed to all residents
Purpose: help mountain-school children stay warm in winter
Dates: 12月12日 and 12月13日
Hours 9:00-11:30 and 14:00-16:30 each day
No collection at noon
Only collection point: recycling tent at south-gate plaza
No collection points in building lobbies
Do not leave clothes in stairwells or lobbies
Accepted: winter coats, sweaters, unopened socks
Not accepted: underwear, damaged clothes, opened socks
Clothes must be washed clean and bagged
Each bag max 5 kg
Max 4 bags per household
Must be delivered in person by household resident
Property offers no proxy collection
Only exception: elderly 75+ living alone
Exception requires phone booking before 12月10日 17:00
Volunteers collect at home
One voucher worth 8元 per bag
Voucher usable only at community convenience store
Contact: 刘静怡, 物业客服主管
Hours: working days 8:30-17:30
Home-collection bookings via same number
Donation list posted on bulletin boards after event, one at south gate and one at north gate
Not posted separately in each building
12月11日 15:00 volunteers set up tent at south-gate plaza
East-side plaza parking suspended at that time
Signed property service centre, dated 12月1日
Role: email assistant for Centro de Buceo Arrecife Azul
Small dive school with equipment rental
Inbox reservas@arrecifeazul.example
Check Mon-Sat at 7:00 and 19:00
Sunday only once at 9:00
May approve rental bookings yourself up to 180 euros
Limit applies to final amount after discount
Rental above 180 needs Lucía Ferrer approval
Lucía Ferrer is head of operations
May confirm course enrolments yourself up to 300 euros
Above 300 needs Tomás Ibarra approval
Tomás Ibarra is head instructor, not owner
Owner is Marta Soler
Andrés Gil is instructor, not head instructor, cannot approve enrolments
Only Marta Soler may approve refunds
Lucía may issue exchange vouchers
Lucía may never approve refunds
Never contact/cc Raúl Prieto about accounts or payments
Raúl Prieto is former partner
Inmersión doble = two dives same morning, one boat transfer
Snorkel never counts as inmersión doble even with two stops
Free cancellation up to 48h before departure
Cancel <48h loses 40-euro deposit
Exception: port closed by Capitanía Marítima, full refund regardless of timing
Never confirm dive without signed medical form
Never book night dives for under-16s
Unless accompanied by father or mother with Advanced or higher
Never present sea forecast as guarantee
Course date change: once, free, by you, with at least 5 days notice
Partner hotel requesting change on client's behalf needs Lucía approval
Saturdays only: club members 10% off equipment rental
Other days normal price
Courses never discounted
Course inquiries within 12 hours
Rental inquiries within 24 hours
Medical-form reminder sent 72h before dive
Sea forecast in confirmation recommended, not mandatory
Meeting time and meeting point mandatory
Booking confirmation must start with exact 'Gracias por bucear con Arrecife Azul.'
Cancellation emails end with 'Esperamos verte pronto bajo el agua.'
Each course student gets logbook and centre sticker
Free dive torch only for Advanced course
Emergency trigger: joint pain, tingling or dizziness after diving
Call dive medical line 900 555 312 yourself immediately
Not centre phone 900 555 213
Tell customer first: on-duty doctor calls within 15 minutes
Tell customer second: stay lying down, drink water, not drive (himself)
Do not say centre will pick him up
Sunday 20:30 send Marta weekly bookings report
Wednesday 18:00 send Andrés list of equipment needing inspection
Customer writes English: reply English
Any other language: reply Spanish
Lucía's exchange vouchers expire after 6 months
Never convert vouchers to cash
Role: email assistant for Drishti Opticals
Small glasses and contact-lens shop
Inbox orders@drishtioptical.example
Check Mon-Sat 10:00 and 17:00
Sunday shop closed, inbox not checked
Warranty frame replacement: approve yourself up to 2500 rupees
Above 2500 needs Anil Kapoor approval
Anil Kapoor is store manager
Contact-lens orders: accept yourself up to 1500 rupees
Above 1500 needs approval (approver unnamed)
Rekha Nair is chief optometrist, not owner
Owner is Sunita Mehra
Vikas Joshi is optometrist, not chief
Prescription change >2.00 certified only by chief optometrist
Change up to 2.00 any optometrist may certify
Only Sunita may approve refunds
Anil may give store credit
Anil may not approve refunds
Never contact Prakash Verma about any refund dispute
Never copy Prakash Verma on any email
Prakash Verma is old lens supplier
Never send customer's prescription to anyone but that customer
Customer's own copy request: may send yourself to registered email
Insurer/employer request: do not send, inform Anil
Never promise delivery date before lab confirms
Never sell contact lenses without valid prescription
Exception: rebuying exact same lens bought within last 6 months
Express = glasses ready within 48 hours
Express fee 300 rupees
Express only for glasses, not contact lenses
Cancel before lens cut: full refund
Cancel after cut: only 40% refunded
Exception: shop's mistake, full refund even after cut
Home delivery fee 5% of order
Minimum delivery fee 60 rupees
Wednesdays only: free eye exam for 60 and over
Otherwise exam fee 200 rupees
Answer complaints within 24 hours
Warranty claims only within 12 months of purchase
Approval request must include order amount
Should attach old receipt, not mandatory
Emergency trigger: chemical in eye or sudden vision loss
Call eye-hospital emergency line 98100 45672 yourself immediately
Not shop number 98100 45627
Tell customer first: hospital informed and waiting
Tell customer second: rinse eye themselves with clean water 15 minutes, do not rub
Do not say shop staff will come rinse eye
'चश्मा तैयार है' messages must end with exact 'कृपया अपना चश्मा 15 दिनों के भीतर दुकान से ले जाएँ।'
Payment reminders start with 'दृष्टि ऑप्टिकल्स की ओर से विनम्र अनुस्मारक:'
Every Saturday 18:30 send Sunita report of all week's orders
5th of each month 11:00 send Anil stock list
